# Rotation and Dopesheet Gizmo Stability Release 🧭 This is a cumulative point release focused on stability and polish, with a couple of new gizmo core features: roll the view by dragging a gizmo, and interactive scene strips in the Dopesheet. This release is built on **Blender 5.3.0 Alpha** (Blender main as of October 7, 2026), with **76** new features, fixes and polish from us since 5.2.0. ### ✨What's new in this release: - **View Roll gizmo** — Drag left or right on the navigation gizmo to roll the view, with an angle indicator while you drag. Roll controls and a hotkey are also in the 3D View sidebar - **Dopesheet Scene Strip gizmos** — Interactive gizmos to edit scene strips directly in the Dopesheet and timeline frame ranges with a gesture - **Sequencer and Timeline** — Ripple Delete, lasso select hotkeys like the other editors, consolidated keyframing tools in the Timeline footers, and consistent frame range icons - **30+ new node icons** — New Geometry Nodes, Shader Light nodes and Compositor nodes now have icons and toolshelf entries, including Comment, XPBD Solver, Construct Curves, Rasterize Points, Grid Solve Poisson, Combine List and Bundle nodes - **Cleaner menus** — Removed double entries (Import FBX, Link to Scene, Snap, Implicit Conversion), Show/Hide submenus in Pose and Weight Paint, and toolshelves that follow the Add menu order - **Bigger splashscreen** with more recent files - **Easier extensions** — Installing and removing legacy pre-downloaded extensions is simpler, and the Asset Libraries filter now has an icon - **Clearer themes** — Node highlights stand out more, and curve handle colors now more legible ### 🧡 Top Usability Features from Blender 5.3 (Alpha): - **Sidebar Search** — Find any property or operator in any editor's sidebar, including add-on tabs - **Custom Outliner Sorting** — Arrange objects anywhere in the Outliner - **Comment Node** — Annotate node trees, with Markdown formatting - **Ripple Editing in the Sequencer** — Ripple, Shuffle and Overwrite overlap modes (R, S, V), Ripple Trim and Ripple Delete - **OpenTimelineIO** — Import and export edits to and from other editing software - **Smarter Scene Strips** — Scene strips update their length on their own, and many datablocks can be dropped straight onto the timeline - **Compositor Effects Stack and Bundle nodes** — Effects organized as a stack, with grouped data handling - **EEVEE Material Lighting Nodes and Panoramic Cameras** — Toon shading and lighting effects, plus equirectangular, fisheye and mirror ball cameras - **Geometry Nodes for Volumes and Curves** — Rasterize Points, Poisson Solver and Construct Curves - **Convert Rotation Mode for Animation** — Convert keyframes between rotation modes with Ctrl+R And many more bug fixes and more! Note: Bforartists follows Blender main, so this release carries Blender 5.3 Alpha code. Files stay fully compatible with Blender. Bforartists 5.3, built on the final Blender 5.3, follows on November 10. ## Cumulative Refinement Release ⚒️ This is a point release with much work on performance, stability and polish. This is part of the latest from Blender 5.2.0 and 5.3.0 to the date - with **56** new features from us. _⚠️ Mac builds coming soon_ ### ✨What's new in this release: - Improved default size for the Node Minimap - Geometry Nodes Mesh Bevel Node, Sort Lists node, Grease Pencil Read nodes, Closure to Lists node, and NURBS Order and Weight nodes - Expose UV move on axis operators to top level - Library operators to open preferences tab, open and clear download Cache - Other refinements to Sequencer, Properties Editor, Outliner, Smart Delete, Compositor, and more ### 🧡 Top Usability Features from Blender 5.2 and 5.3: **From 5.2.0:** - **Node-Based Physics (XPBD Solver)** — Brand new procedural hair & cloth simulations with customizable constraints - **Mesh Bevel Node** — Long-awaited procedural edge/vertex bevel control in Geometry Nodes - **Online Asset Libraries** — Dozens of materials, HDRs, and node groups downloadable on demand - **EEVEE Screen Space Raytracing Overhaul** — Backface tracing, reduced banding, faster GI, and major stability fixes - **Cycles Texture Cache** — Automatic optimized textures, drastically reducing memory usage - **Grease Pencil Delaunay Fill** — Exact geometry fill with gap detection, inverse filling, and faster performance - **Playback Loop Modes** — Infinite, Stop at End/Start, Bounce, and Restore Frame modes - **Sculpt Add Primitive Tool** — Drop cubes, cones, spheres directly into sculpts - **Compositor Gizmo Auto Keying** — Transform gizmos auto-insert keyframes in backdrop & Image Editor - **Thin Wall Mode (Principled BSDF)** — Physically accurate thin materials (paper, leaves, glass) **From 5.3.0 (Alpha):** - **Vulkan Default Renderer** — Vulkan backend now default on Windows & Linux; hardware ray traced shadows in Workbench - **Compositor Playback Caching** — Interactive compositor caches playback; up to 2x faster GPU performance - **Sequencer Ripple Delete** — Auto-close gaps when deleting strips (Shift+X) - **Sequencer Strip Thumbnails** — Scene, Text, Mask and MovieClip strips now show thumbnails in timeline - **Sculpt Automasking in Vertex/Weight Paint** — Topology, boundary, cavity, and normal masking support - **Animation Scrubbing Pauses Playback** — Scrubbing now pauses playback, resumes on release - **Node Editor Link Highlighting** — Highlight links through reroute nodes for clearer node trees - **Sculpt Transform Only Pivot** — Control pivot placement with transform gizmo without affecting geometry - **Outliner Scroll to New Collection** — Auto-scroll and auto-rename newly added collections - **Improved Brushes & Weight Paint Defaults** — Updated essential brushes, better defaults, and Cut Curves hair brush And many more bug fixes and more! ## The Node Editor Upgrade Hotfix Version 🍝
![Bforartists 5 0 1 - Splash Large](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/59d870d5-cd43-40d9-90db-5141246266ba)
![Bforartists 5 0 1 Screenshot](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/091e57b3-cdae-43da-8a5f-b85ffb9f0a59)

This point version is a stablity and hotfix release focused on new Compositor assets that come out of the box, new smart asset updates and apply operators, and much much love to the node editors.

This is part of all the latest from Blender 5.0.1 and 5.1.0 to the date - with **53** new fixes and polish with much stability from Blender!

⚠️ **Warning:** `*.Blend `File formats from this version onwards will not be backwards compatible with earlier versions of Blender 4.5.x or Bforartists 4.4.x. It's a one way trip!

### What's new:
- Fixed the export/import unusable File dialogue when using the Bforartists hotkeys
- More Icons in data types in Geometry Nodes Selectors
- Fixed instancing options from the Asset Shelf drag and drop
- Fixed Dopesheet missing operators
- Fixed Hotkey dropdown icon
- Cleaned up the Node Editor Sidebars to be consistent with Add menu
- Cleaned up the Preferences NDOF settings

### Additional Features from this Blender 5.0.x and 5.1.x series:
- New Bone Info node for Geoemtry Nodes

And many bug fixes more!

Downloads available from both Github, the official Website, Windows store and Blender Launcher v2

**📥 Downloads:**
https://www.bforartists.de/download/

**🪟 Windows App**
[Windows App Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9P3PLMNRD4SC?hl=en-us&gl=CO&ocid=pdpshare)

[For Arch](https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/blender-launcher-v2-bin)

**📝 Release Notes:**
https://www.bforartists.de/release-notes/

🗒️ Blender Release notes now merged and updated into Bforartists:
https://www.blender.org/download/releases/

Splashscreen is kindly provided by **Bluenile3D**, the latest winner of the Splashscreen submissions competition hosted in the Discord server! Thank you!

And also, thanks again for all art, love, feedback and help for making the Bforartists community what it is today! Without your feedback and support, this wouldn't be possible

_Draise, Reiner, Blenux (Juso), Znight (Trung Pham), Quackers, Eyad, Sean and all you arty supporters_

## The Asset Shelf Usability Upgrade Hotfix Release ![Bforartists 4 5 0 - Splash Large](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/00a294c3-689e-48b4-9a09-a7f53cf5b464) ![Bforartists 4 5 1 Screenshot](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fb5bca50-591b-4f9e-81f2-26e6865f051a) This is a stability update to the release that has brought us much much love to the Asset Shelves usability with many new accumulated details and features from Bforartists and Blender. This is part of all the latest from Blender 4.5.1 and 5.0.0 to the date - with **34** new pieces of love from us and another 89 and some fixes from Blender ⚠️ **Warning:** `*.Blend `File formats from this version onwards will not be backwards compatible with earlier versions of Blender 4.5.x or Bforartists 4.4.x. It's a one way trip! ## What's new: - Fixed the library override also linking when using the Libary Override mode from the Assetshelf/Browser - Fixed many small details like checkboxes floating left - Updated the Blend Normals by Proximity asset to be more robust, predictable and also set ground work to material blending also - Documentation is has started to be refactored and updated - Blender themes fixed
What's new in this series: - New Asset Shelf mode import properties - new add asset with overrides automatically from shelf/browser - ![Bforartists 4 5 0 Screenshot - Asssetshelf](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/85096b93-c613-4212-8bba-f6fa9f037863) - New Default Assets: - Blend Normals by Proximity - Inherit Smoothness - Inherit Material - Mesh Lines and Silhouette - Object/World Normal - Group operators in the node editors are now in the toolshelf - Cleanup and Refactor for the Node Editors sidebar add panels - New Granular display of nodegroups in the sidebar - Presentation Addon New Slides operator - Node Group socket interface and operators got UX love - Interface Updates - More robust columns for the tabbed toolshelf - Theme panel visual updates - Updated default Hotkeys
Additional Features from this Blender 4.4.x and 5.0.x series: - New Playhead Header submenu - Sculpt Modes - New Mask to Geometry operators - New Color Jitter in Brushes now exposed to side bar also - Built In attributes now show in header of Spreadsheet - Point Cloud Edit mode is getting love - Light properties have new settings and consistenty layout - Exposure and Temperature - Consistency with Cycles - Collada removed (but we may have another in development) - New Compositor nodes - Image Coordinates - Relative to Pixel - Texture Nodes - Input sockets - Changes to color correction nodes - Shader - New Volume Coefficient Shader - Grease Pencil Antialiasing made more explicit - New Animation Timeline Footers - Scenes can be saved as assets now - Compositor Node Trees are a thing now - New Grease Pencil operators - Split - Remove Fill Guides - Outline - Convert to Curve type - Mask above and below - New relocate linked asset operator - Per Bone type visibility - Shape Key copying - Camera OSL scripts included - Performance in tesselation, subdivision, and more - Grease Pencil Fill Guide indicators - Vulkan Backend - Sequencer HDR support - Sequencer slip improved - Drag and drop collections to surfaces - Cursor rotation for snapping - Asset Screenshots - Gizmos in the Compositor
And much _**much**_ more Downloads available from both Github, the official Website, Windows store and Blender Launcher v2 📥 Download for Free today! Let us know what you think of this big release! 🌍 Official Website [Website Download Link](https://www.bforartists.de/download/) 🪟 Windows App [Windows App Store](https://www.microsoft.com/store/productId/9PD5L5XBRMR0?ocid=pdpshare) 🧡 Blender Launcher [Blender Launcher v2 Download](https://github.com/Victor-IX/Blender-Launcher-V2/releases) 📄 Release Notes: [Release Notes on Website](https://www.bforartists.de/release-notes/) 🖥️ Source Code [Github Repository](https://github.com/Bforartists) Splashscreen is kindly provided by Prashan Subsinghe, the latest winner of the Splash Screen competition hosted in the Discord server! Thank you! And also, thanks again for all artwork, love, feedback and help for making the Bforartists community what it is today! _Draise, Reiner, Blenux (Juso), Znight (Trung Pham), Quackers, Eyad, Sean and all you arty supporters_
